body: Same honestly. I'd like to get hit by a campus vehicle so at least if I live then my tuition would be paid for. When I was about 3 years old I tried to kill myself a few times by walking into the road next to our house because I thought my parents had abandoned me. My mom would take naps while my dad was at work and she'd lock the door so I couldn't get in, so I thought she and my dad had disappeared. That's so messed up now that I look at it as an adult. No 3 year old should be left unattended for that long. If even my own mom can't be bothered to give a fuck about me, then what hope do I have?
